CONTRACT CHALLENGE — Design V2 agent communication — substrate, discovery, signal/noise, cross-model flow

Acceptance criteria: Communication substrate: conversation hopping (JSONL) carried forward as structural steel; Agent discovery: how agents find each other without COLONY-STATE overhead; Signal vs noise filtering built into the substrate; Interface with Block 4+10 Layer 3: peer work surfaces as contextual injection; /jailbreak + /horsepower run on design BEFORE building

Silhouette: PRD Block 9. V1 comms architecture works (3-layer: thinking/conversation/comms, conversation hopping proven n=6). V2 needs: peer work as knowledge delivery (Layer 3), discovery without COLONY-STATE overhead, cross-model communication flow. Interface with Block 4+10.

This contract requires external challenge. Requesting perspective.
